content:
The files in Archive have essentially not been touched save for mathlib-wide refactors ever since they were created. Some of them have set_options as a result, but the main consequence is that they do not reflect the vastly improved tactics/API we have in mathlib.

#43434 cleans up ZagierTwoSquares.
#43565 cleans up FriendshipGraphs.

I would like these PRs to be reviewed and merged.
